insights.title: Open & Click Tracking Now Live — 153 Opens, 63 Clicks in Period
insights.detail: Baseline had no email open/click data. Now tracking: 5.07% overall open rate, 2.09% click rate. Kitchen Renovation leads at 10.82% OR / 3.03% CR.

insights.title: Kitchen Renovation Is the Top Performer
insights.detail: Email 3 hit 15.79% open rate and 8.77% click rate — 5x the average click rate. 1,383 total members with 1,285 still queued represents the biggest pipeline.

insights.title: Email Volume Scaled +80% Over Baseline
insights.detail: 1,341 new executions this period vs. 1,676 all-time baseline. 3,160 not-started members queued across 5 active sequences — massive future pipeline.

insights.title: Email Sending Limit Increased to 30/Day
insights.detail: All 5 active sequences share 1 sending account — limit raised from 15 to 30 emails/day this period to unlock queue throughput.

insights.title: SMS Delivery at 73.16% — 62 of 231 Failed
insights.detail: Whole House Renovation SMS Day 3: 231 total sends, 169 delivered (73.16%), 62 failed (26.84%). The 62 failures need investigation — invalid numbers, carrier blocks, or intermittent phone integration issues. Delivery IS happening, unlike the platform aggregate previously suggested.

insights.title: Outdoor Living Sequence Just Starting — 33 of 683 Reached
insights.detail: Only Email 1 has fired so far (33 sent, 2 clicks at 6.06% CR). With the shared 30/day sending cap across 5 active sequences, each sequence gets ~6 emails/day. The 650 remaining members will ramp gradually — this is expected pacing under the shared cap, not a performance issue.

insights.title: LinkedIn Channel Dormant This Period
insights.detail: Baseline had 988 connection requests, 171 accepted, 44 replies on LinkedIn. No Prosp campaigns active this period per client confirmation. 13 paused sequences include legacy ICP outreach versions.

insights.title: 347 Pending Approvals — Normal Queue with 30/Day Shared Cap
insights.detail: 347 pending executions reflect the queue backing up behind a single shared sending account (30 emails/day across all 5 sequences). With 3,160 queued members, this is expected — the increased limit (up from 15/day) is actively helping clear the backlog.

nextSteps.action: Investigate 62 SMS failures — 26.84% failure rate on Whole House sequence
